219)༄༅/gzhi bdag bsang mchod 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs bzhugs/ /220)༄༅/oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/dpal yon spungs sogs sbas yul gser ldan 'khyil pa'i gzhi

tei:div.tei:p: 219)༄༅/ gzhi bdag bsang mchod 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs bzhugs// 220)༄༅/ oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/

dpal yon spungs sogs sbas yul gser ldan 'khyil pa'i gzhi bdag chen po rnams kyi bsang mchod dmigs bsal bya bar 'dod pas/ lha bsang rgyal gyi gzhi bdag mchod pa'i skabs su babs pa na 'di ltar brjod do/ oṃ/ dag pa ye shes rang rtsal gyis// ma dag snang ba'i dngos kun sbyangs// zhing khams kun khyab mchod pa'i sprin// nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐// oṃ āḥhūm̐// ring bang spun rnams ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'od gsal 221)dbyings kyi thig le las// rang byung kun bzang mchod pa'i rdzas// phyi nang gsang ba lhun grub pa// bsam yas rol pa chen po dang*// dad cing mos pas legs sbyar ba// bdud rtsi can shing bsangs kyi sprin// ro brgya dang ldan gser skyems dang*// gtor tshogs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa yis// tshangs pa rdo rje dkar po bsangs// kong po rdo rje dpal 222)brtsegs bsang*// phywa lha tshangs pa dkar po= gnyan ldang rdo rje blo gros= spu bo rdo rje gzhon nu= smir ti rdo rje ye shes= rog po rdo rje phur bu= tsha ba'i rdo rje dgra 'dul= zil khrom rdo rje g.yung drung= gnas po rdo rje gur mgon= smra mol rdo rje ngang dkar= bod skyong gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas// mchod sprin rgya mtshos thugs dam skang*// bstod dbyangs rol mos mnga' chen gsol// gser skyems phud kyis gzi mdangs bskyed// bzang shing dud pas mnol ba bsang*// ma rig dbang gis nongs pa'i las// 'gyod pas bshags so tshangs pa stsol// kun tu dgyes pa'i sku gsung thugs// sprin bral zla ba rgyas pa las// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang gis// 'dod rgu'i re ba skong bar mdzod// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du// nyes tshogs mun pa kun zhi zhing*// legs 223)dgu'i snang ba rgyas pa yi// phan bdes 'jig rten kun khyab shog rdo gnyan ni/

rang gi mdun du lha yi dgra bla chen po rdo rje drag po rtsal sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis cang shes dkar po la bcibs pa/ phyag g.yas drag po'i ba dan nam mkha' dbyings su phyar ba/ g.yon pas chos dung dkar po snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' dang nor bu rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa la 'dod dgu'i char 'bab pa 'khor yul lha 'bum gyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ srung ma lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ni// rdo gnyan rmad bu rdo rje drag po rtsal// rnal 'byor sgrub mchog skyong phyir 'dir byon 'tshal// gsang sngags bstan pa spel phyir 'dir byon 'tshal// dgos 'dod re ba bskang phyir 'dir 224)byon 'tshal// badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ oṃ/ gtsang mar sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi'i dud sprin tshogs// 'dod yon du ma'i mchod pa'i sprin 'khrigs nas// ting 'dzin zas bzhin dgos 'dod tshim mdzad pa'i// lha mi'i dpal 'byor 'dod 'byung bdud rtsis mchod// bstod pa bya ba ni/ rdo gnyan rmad bu rdo rje drag po 'tshal// dge bsnyen tshul 'chang gsang sngags bstan pa spel// rta pa go bcas bstan dgra bar chad sgrol// rin chen rgyan spras dgos 'dod re ba skong*// bzhin gyi mdangs ldan dus sum lung yang ston// rdo gnyan rmad bu rdo rje drag rtsal bstod// ma g.yel dgra lha mthu bo che// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang*// khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*// dgra bgegs myur du med par mdzod// mi la na tsha med pa dang*// nor la god 225)kha med par mdzod// rtag tu srung skyobs sdong grogs mdzod/ /klong gsal snying pos so// sa sdom ni/ kyai/ 'dod 'byung nor bu'i rdzong chen la// brten bcas gnas dag gter gyi bdag /sa sdom rdo rje legs pa'i btsan// pho nya bran dang mngags gzhug bcas// 'khor dang bcas thams cad la// bdud rtsi can shing bsregs pa yi// dri zhim bsang gi mchod pa 'bul// 'bru sna phye mar ja chang phud// dngos 'byor yid sprul dgyes pa'i rdzas// nam mkha' gang bas gsol lo mchod// ma rig nongs pa'i dri ma kun// rten 'brel nus pas dag gyur nas// gzi mdangs yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas// dbu 'phang nyi zla'i dpal ltar mtho// yul khams dge legs snang bas khyab// khyad par gsol zhing mchod pa la// 'dod rgu'i

226)dngos grub 'bad med stsol// rtag par dge ba'i stong grogs mdzod// rdo ye ni/ kyai/ srid pa rgyud kyi srung ma che// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tha tshig can// rdo phe rdo rje khyung drag rtsal// 'khor g.yog sde dpung bcas pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bsang dang mchod pa bzhes// ma g.yel rdo rje'i tha tshig dgongs// pad 'byung bstan pa dar rgyas spel// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe srings// bdag cag 'khor bcas byang chub bar// bar gcod bdud sogs mi mthun phyogs// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zlog chos mthun tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas// phyi ru dus kyi rgud pa sol// nang du lus kyi nad gdon choms// gsang ba dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// sman ri ni/ kyai// 'bri rgyud sbas pa'i yul gyi dbus/ 227)/dbyibs legs lhun chags sa 'dzin gyi// ba gam rang byung pho brang nas// sman ri rdo rje dpal ldan brtsegs// sna tshogs sprul pa'i cho 'phrul bcas// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// deng sang snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug bstan dang bstan 'dzin dbu 'phang dma'// bdud dang dam sri mgo bo mtho// skye 'gro'i bde skyid gting nas bri// gtsang ris lha srung dgung du yal// mi 'dod sna dgu sprin ltar 'thibs// dam chos sgrub la bar chad mang*// 'di 'dra'i dus ngan shar ba'i tshe// nyam thag bstan 'gro mi skyob par// thog ma'i dam tshig bsnyel lam ci// ma g.yel thugs rje'i stobs bskyed la// dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa sol// gang bcol phrin las myur du sgrubs// dzing ra ni/ kyai/ mgur lha gnyan po mthu 228)rtsal can// dzing ra rdo rje dbang chen btsan// sprul dang yang 'khor bsam mi khyab// 'dir gshegs bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// a ti'i mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yi// bdag cag mos pa'i bu la dgongs// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang*// gshis ngan 'chi rkyen thams cad zlog

sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa sol// mi mthun dal kha mkha' la bsgyur// king kang gzer mda' bgegs la rgyob// phyi ru dus kyi rgud pa sol// nang du lus kyi nad gdon choms// gsang ba dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ ba nye ni/ kye// chos skyong rgyal po lha yi gtso// ba nye bkra shis g.yu rtsa ni// gnam sa phyed kyi mnga' bdag mdzad// stong gsum skad cig gcig la bskor// ser chags 229) kun gyi dgra bla ste// ban bon yongs kyi bstan pa srungs// pad+ma thod phreng dam tshig can// khyad par snying tig bka' gter skyongs// gnam sa bar gsum sprul pas gang*// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// khyod kyi mthu rtsal deng bskul lo// bdag cag mos pa'i bu la gzigs// dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol// bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dgung du spor// 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med nor// 'dod rgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// so tho ni/ kyai// 'bri klung gser ldan 'bab pa'i rgyud// dam pa'i chos kyis phyug pa'i yul// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dge bsnyen che// so tho rdo rje kun grags rtsal// sku mdog dkar gsal mdzes pa la// dri med dar gyi zhwa gos brjid// phyag g.yas dpa' bo'i ru dar phyar// g.yon pas 'phrul gyi me 230)long 'dzin// rta dkar rlung shugs rgyan ldan bcibs// 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes// ngad bzang shing sna kun tshogs pa'i// dag byed bsangs kyis mchod pa 'bul// nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan dang*// bkra shis rtags rdzas rgyal srid bdun// rat+na 'bru sman dar zab dang*// phye mar 'o skol rgya ja dang*// g.yag lug ra gsum 'dod 'jo'i ba// rta drel ri g.yung sna tshogs dang*// dkar gsum mngar gsum las grub pa'i// dam rdzas gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti u pa si ka sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃta kha kha khā hi/

zhes lan bdun gyis bsngo/ yul bdag dgra lha gnyan po ni// 'khor dang bcas la mchod cing bstod// sngon tshe rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa yi// bka' dang dam tshig ma 'da' bar// pad+ma'i ring lugs rnam dag spel/ bstan 'dzin 231)bzhed pa ma lus sgrubs// chos kyi grwa 'di dar zhing rgyas// de la mi mthun mtha' dag srungs// yul khams bde zhing mi phyugs 'phel// lo legs bde skyid dpal la spyod// bdag gis gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// rdo rje drag pos so/// dmar 'gu ni/ kyai/ dkar phyogs lha rnams rgyal ba dang*// nag phyogs bdud rigs pham mdzad pa// btsan rgod rdo rje dmar po che// sprul dang yang 'khor bsam mi khyab// 'dir gshegs bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// bar chad bdud kyi 'phrang las sgrol// dam sri 'byung po'i tsha ngar choms// dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol// dgyes pa'i zhal gyi 'dzum ston la// byams pa'i thugs kyis dgyes par dgongs// mchod na kha 'dzin rgyab brten mdzod// brngan na yid la gang 'dod sgrubs// brten na mgon skyabs stong grogs gyis// gzhis byes kun 232)tu bkra shis shing*// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang*// phas rgol mi mthun zhi ba sogs// mdor na yid la gang 'dod pa// myur du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// mchod bstod byas pas ngo ma chung*// ma shes las la phrag ma dog rtag tu byams pas rjes dgongs la// bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ra nu ni/ kyai// srid gsum zil gnon he ru ka /rig 'dzin pad+ma badz+ra gyi// bka' dang dam tshig legs 'chang ba'i// drag shul mi bzad bdud kyi rje// sku mdog mthing nag zhi ma khro// dar nag zhwa gos dpa' chas brjid// g.yas na mdung dar nag po dang*// g.yon na bdud zhags nag po 'dzin// shugs ldan glog gi bang rtsal can// rta nag rting dkar rgyan ldan chibs// btsun mo sras dang blon

233)'khor bcas// dam tshig dbang gi 'dir gshegs bzhugs// dri zhim spos kyi ljon pa'i tshogs// dag byed zhugs la sbar ba yi// bdud rtsi sprin phung 'khrigs pa yis// bsang gis thugs 'gal dag gyur cig /mchod yon mdangs tshal me tog dang*// bdug spos ma me dri cha ba dang*// bda' dgu'i zhal zas rol mo dang*// 'dod yon spyan gzigs sna tshogs 'bul// phye mar zas phud du ma dang*// myos byed gser phye sbyar ba'i skyems// mgyogs 'gro rkang bzhi ri skyes tshogs// gzugs 'gros mthun pa'i yo byad 'bul/ oṃ las rin chen snod mchog tu/ khaṃ yig 'od zhu gtor rdzas rnams// sngags rgya'i nus pas bdud rtsir spel// yul bdag 'khor bcas dgyes rol mdzod// oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra i dam ba liṃta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis 'phul/ hrīḥ mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul rgya mtsho la/ 234) /dbang bsgyur mi bsrun bdud kyi rje// 'jig rten las la grub pa yi// dregs pa 'khor dang bcas la bstod// rgyal ba gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung*// rig 'dzin thugs mchog drag rtsal gyi// bka' dang dam tshig dran mdzod la// gang bcol phrin las sgrub mdzad gsol// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// de 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa yi// sku tshe srings la mdzad phrin spel// gzhis byes bya ba gang brtsam yang*// ru nga phrag dog gnod 'tshe spongs// gtsug lag chos kyi grwa 'di la// mgon skyabs phrin las rtag par skyongs// rdo rje drag pos so// ser po blo gros ni/ hrīḥ rdo rje thod phreng rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sdes// dbang bskur dam mnos gsang sngags bstan skyong du// gnyer bskos tha tshig 'gyur med gnas srung che// dge bsnyen ser po blo gros mtshan 'chang ba// sku mdog dkar gsal zhi 'dzum paṇa 235)zhu spras// dge tshul chas bgos mda' dar gter bum 'dzin// rta dkar rin chen rgyan ldan chibs su bcibs// rnam bzhi'i phrin las rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// 'khor bcas dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis// yul lha 'khor cas thugs la mnyes pa'i rdzas// so so'i 'dod dgu'i longs spyod phun tshogs gyur// oṃ a ko ro

lan gsum/ ngo bo bde stong dbang shes tshim byed pa'i// rnam pa dri zhim ngad ldan spos sprin gyis// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'dod yon lnga// lha srung 'khor bcas dgyes pa dbyings su bskang*// mtho ris 'byor tshogs kun tu chags pa'i rtser// rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen spyan gzigs dar// bya gcan ri g.yung gzugs 'gros ji snyed pa// mos blos yid kyis 'bul lo dgyes par rol// bstan la dga' ba'i 246)yul bdag mthu rtsal can// legs nyes byed po chos mdzad skyong la bstod// dkar dmar thab sogs khyod thugs 'gal ba'i las// ci bgyis nongs pa ma lus snying nas bshags// rgyal dbang pad+ma thugs mchog rtsal gyi bka'// ma g.yel rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs sde// phyogs dus kun nas dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing*// de 'dzin skyes bu'i bzhed don phrin las spel// snod bcud 'byung ba'i rgud pa ma lus sol// gzhis byes bya ba gang brtsams kha 'dzin mdzod// chos srid legs tshogs phywa dang g.yang du khug /tshogs gnyis 'bras bur smin pa'i bkra shis stsol/ 'gyur med nges don bstan 'dzin gyis so// sde ring ni/ hūm̐// rol rtsal chos dbyings mkha' lam nas// ye shes sprul pa'i gar bsgyur ba'i// sna tshogs sprul mdzad bstan srung che// mthu ldan ma rung dgra bo'i gshed// dge gnyen rdo rje 'bar ba ni/ 237)/thugs rje chags bral kha dog dmar// bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms mdung thung g.yas// log rtog tshar gcod cit+ta g.yon// srid zhir dbang bsgyur ber chen gsol// gdug tshogs 'dzoms mdzad khro gnyer can// bdud bzhi zil gnon mche bzhi gtsigs// stobs bcu'i rtsal rdzogs khrag ral g.yo// rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan ra skyes zhon// gling bzhi'i skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs// srid gsum kun la bya ra byed/ khyed ni dam tshig can gyi bdag dam la gnas bzhin da tshur byon// dkar gsum sbyar ba'i phye mar dang*// rin chen bcud ldan dza gad chang*// dri ldan g.yu shug bsang mchod sogs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// rgyal kun bka' dang tha tshig bzhin// mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa sol// mthun rkyen legs tshogs lhun grub nas// 'gro kun rdzogs ldan dpal gnas shog

238)khyad par rgyal bstan rin po che// phyogs med bstan pa mthar rgyas zhing*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan// thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub 'phel// bslab gsum rnam dag mdzad phrin las rgyas// mi mthun rgud pa'i chos kun sol// legs dgu'i dpal la rtag gnas shing*// mnga' thang nam mkha'i mtha mnyam zhing*// bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs shog

gtsug ra ni/ kyai// dga' ba brgya ldan nor 'dzin khyon// skyong mdzad dge gnyen gtsug ra gnyan// gtsug phram la sogs 'khor dang bcas// rin chen rgyan cha 'od du 'tsher// dar mdung ru mtshon 'tshubs bse tshub// ki bswo cha sgra di ri ri// gzhan gyis mi tub dpung dang bcas// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// bzang shing sna tshogs dud pas bsangs// rin chen sman 'bru dar snas brngan// gzugs 'gros dkor cha sna tshogs 'bul// ja chang 'o zho'i skyems kyis 239)mchod// phye mar zas sna'i phud la rol// thugs la bzhed rgu'i mchod sprin gyis// gnas bdag 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod// rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod// chos sde 'di yi bstan pa spel// gnod byed dgra jag chom rkun srungs// 'dod rgu lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// 'go pho ni/ kyai/ rnam rgyal rab rtan chos kyi gling*// skyong mdzad khyad par 'phags pa'i lha// 'go pho rdo rje bgegs dpung 'joms// zla ba gsar pa'i 'dzum mdangs can// g.yu yi go khrab si li li// dar 'phru rgod 'phru spungs se spung*// 'khor gsum rno ldan sked la bskor// phyag g.yas dar mdung nam mkhar bsgreng*// bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dgung du bstod// g.yon pas 'dod 'byung nor bu bsnams// sgrub la dngos grub sna tshogs ster// rta sngon chu ris ldan pa chibs// btsun mo sras dang lha klu yi/ 240)/dge bsnyen mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'dir gshegs bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// kha 'dzin rgyab brten sdong grogs dang*// bsam rgu yid bzhin 'grub bar mdzod/ khra ze ni/ kyai/ sbas yul gnyan gyi srung ma che// khra ze rdo rje ri bkra che// btsun mo sras 'khor sprul par bcas// 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// bzang shing du sprin nam mkha' gang*// 'bru sna phye mar ri ltar spungs// ja chang 'o zho mtsho ltar bskyil// rin chen dkor cha gram bur brdal// dar zab shing rtsi 'ja' ltar bkra// shel tshig khri kar stong nag sogs// ting nge 'dzin gyis byin brlabs pas// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga// gzugs 'gros yid 'ong sa gzhi khyab// dgyes rdzas gtsang zhing ma tshang med// ci 'dod mkho rgu 'byung ba yis// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo/

241) /snod bcud rgud pa ma lus zhi// 'jig rten bde legs dpal gyis 'byor// 'gro kun chos bzhin spyod pa dang*// bsam don 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ dong 'di ni/ kyai/ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bkod sdod che// dong 'di rdo rje bdud dpung 'joms// sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas// bsang do mchod do mnga' gsol lo// nyams grib phog pa bsang gis bsangs// mkhon gcugs zhugs pa bshags pas sdum// mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus// dbu 'phang btsan zhing 'byor pa phyug 'khor mang stobs dang ldan gyur te// gzi brjid mnga' thang phun tshogs shog bsten mchod sgrub la dgyes dgongs te// gzhis la 'dug na 'tsho rdzi mdzod// byes su 'gro na sdong grogs mdzod// dgra rkun gcan zan 'tshe ba sogs// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams 242)zlog /'dod don bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs/ kha 'dzin rgyan brten srung skyobs sogs// ci bcol las rnams mdzad du gsol// dpal 'dzom ni/ kyai/ gzhi bdag gnyan po khyed rnams ni// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir da byon 'tshal// dgyes pa'i dam rdzas 'bul lags na// shel tshig khri dkar stong nag 'di// dkar mo g.yang mo lug brgya 'bul// nag po zal le 'bri brgya 'bul/ kham pa 'gying ba g.yag brgya 'bul// dkar gtor dmar gtor rgyan can dang*// 'brang rgyas zhal dkar ri ltar spungs// 'gying g.yag rnams ni ngar skad chems se chem// g.yag lug rnams ni bal spu lhubs se lhub// ra skyes rnams ni smrig sgra sha ra ra// 'di 'dra'i dam rdzas mang pos brngan// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// mi nor longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ kyai/ gung sngon mthon po'i 243)mar zhabs nas// rgya mtsho chen po'i yang steng nas// brag dkar rdzong gi bar shed nas// mkhar ni dgra bla gnyan po'i mkhar// de dgra bla brtsegs pa'i sku mkhar yin// yab ni btsan gyi dgra bla rje// yum ni mtsho sman rgyal mo yin// sras ni brag btsan dgra bla yin// dpal 'dzom gnyan po dgra bla dpal// lha btsan gnyan po dgra bla yin// sngags 'chang bdag gi chos skyong yin// bstan dgra dam nyams gshed ma yin// mchod na kun gyi mgon skyabs byed// dpal 'dzom gnyan po bzhugs lags pas// dgra bla dpa' rten mthu rtsal can// sprul pa du ma mdzad tsam na// sku ni 'jigs pa'i gzi brjid can// dung gi 'od zer dkar po 'phro// dbu la dung rmog dkar po gsol// dar dkar rgod phru pu ru ru// sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol// za 'og

244)ber chen 'ja' ris mnabs// g.yu 'od 'phro ba'i gong lag can// stag dong khra bo g.yas nas bkra// gzig shub thig le g.yon na bkra/ ya tsa dkar po glog ltar 'gyu// chibs su ngang pa g.yu rngog bcibs// za 'og dar stan lhubs se lhub// gser sga rgyan chen ngang se ngang*// gser khrab g.yu mthur si li li// g.yu yi yob chen sga ra ra// phyag g.yas dngul gyi bum pa bsnams// g.yon na dar mdung khra bo phyar// lha mi 'bum yang las la bskul// dgra bo dam nyams bkugs nas khrid// stong phrag brgyad bcu'i 'khor gyis bskor// sga stod smad bar gsum mnga' bdag mdzad// btsan rgod 'bum sde pho nyar 'gyed// dgung sngon mtho la byon tsam na// khyung chen lding ba chibs su bcibs// stong gsum khams kun gshog pas khebs// thog dang ser ba bu yug 245)'tshubs// dgra bgegs ma lus brlag par mdzod// bar snang khams su byon pa'i tshe// g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs su bcibs// 'brug sgras stong gsum khams kun gang*// dgra bgegs bla tshe srog gsum khug bstan dgra las ngan tshe srog chod// brag dkar rtse la byon tsam na// bya rgyal thang dkar chibs su bcibs// stag chas sna dgu lus la brgyan// sku ni brjid pa'i dpa' chas can// dpa' bo go cha'i rgyan dang ldan// 'khor du bdud btsan 'bum gyis bskor// sngags 'chang bdag gi mgon skyabs mdzod// skyes bu kun gyi pho lha byed// mchod bsten kun gyi sdong grogs byed// na chung sman gyi yid kyang 'phrog /mi nor rnams kyi rdzi bu byed// rang gi bu rta'i kha 'dzin mdzod// dgra bo'i mi nor gtan nas brlag /bstan dgra dam nyams tshe srog chod// ltas ngan thams cad dgra la thongs/ 246)khyed ni sku yi che ba'i gzugs// sha la dga' ba'i rngams dga' bo/ khrag la dga' ba'i 'jigs tshul can// bden rdzun kun gyi drangs mkhan po// yag nyes lta ba'i spyan rnon po// lha g.yag sham po 'di dag dang*// bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/

rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub stsol// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// sngags 'chang bdag gi stong grogs mdzod/ khyod kyi bskul ba'i lcam mo ni// brag dkar sngon po'i rdzong chen nas// g.yu yi bud med sngon mo yis// sku la dar dkar dgos su gsol// phyag g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// g.yon pas dngul dkar me long phyi// zhol na chu mig sngon mo 'bab// sri'u gso ba'i las mkhan mo// rtse la g.yu shug sngon po skyes// rta lug nor gyi rdzi bu mdzod// 'bru zan spel ba'i dngos grub stsol// chibs su chu glang sngon mo bcibs// dgra 247)lha gnyan gyi bya ra mo// sngags 'chang bdag gi mgon skyabs mdzod// bstan dgra 'dul ba'i phrin las mdzod// da lta ming po 'bod tsa na// ma thogs myur du da tshur byon// g.yag rgod sham po 'di dag dang*// bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ kyai/ khyod kyi g.yon gyi phyogs rol na// sku bla rin chen zur gsum ni// dkar mo dung gi ze ba bsnams// sku la dar nag na bza' gsol// dbu la rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// chibs su rgya stag dmar po bcibs// lha klu sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor// sdang byed dgra la chad pa chod// rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs mdzod// lha g.yag sham po 'di dag dang*// bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ kyai/ dgra bla dpal 'dzam gnyan po la// 'khor dang sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ 248) /g.yas na lha dmag skar ltar 'khrugs// g.yon na btsan dmag me ltar 'bar// mdun na gnyan dmag rlung ltar 'tshubs// rgyab na bdud dmag mun ltar gtibs// 'og na klu dmag chu ltar 'khrugs// gzhan yang sprul pa grangs med rnams// mi dkar rta dkar lha yi dmag /phyag na dar mdung dkar po phyar// mi ser rta ser gnyan gyi dmag /phyag na dar mdung ser po phyar// mi dmar rta dmar btsan gyi dmag

/phyag na dar mdug dmar po phyar// mi khra rta khra sa bdag dmag /phyag na dar mdung khra bo bsnams// mi nag rta nag bdud kyi dmag /phyag na dar mdung nag po phyar// mi sngon rta sngon klu yi dmag /phyag na dar mdung sngon po phyar// de ring sdang byed dgra la chas tsa na// nam mkha' thams cad dmag gis gang*// bar snang khams kun dar gyis gang*/ 249) /nam mkha' dar gyi 'gengs la rgyugs// sa gzhi rta yi gang la rgyugs// de ring bsang mchod gang 'dir yar brngan no// bdag dang yon bdag mgon skyabs mdzod// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// dgra bo mi nor rdul du rlogs// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// de ring dgra lha dpal 'dzam dgra la chas tsa na// wer ma'i dpa' khrom chas pa 'dra// bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /mi la na tsha ma btang cig /phyugs la god kha ma btang cig /zhing la btsa' sad ser gsum ma btang cig /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la stsol/ lab ston nam mkha' rin chen gyis so// g.yag thod ni/ kyai// 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol yid bzhin nor// dbul ba'i 'jigs skyob nor gyi lha// g.yag thod bkra shis bum pa bzang*// 'dir bshegs bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// 'khor 'das 250)brtan g.yo'i phun tshogs dpal// gnas 'dir sdus la gong du spel// bkra shis dge legs rab rgyas mdzod// ting 'dzin byin rlabs bsang mchod kyis// snod kyi nyes skyon rgud pa bsangs// rnam dag pad+ma drwa ba'i zhing*// bkod pa phun tshogs g.yang du 'khyil// 'pho med sdom pa'i gtsang byed kyis// bcud kyi sems can nyon mongs bsangs// rnam dag sku dang ye shes ngang*// 'gyur med bde chen g.yang du 'khyil// rang rig rtog bral 'od gsal gyis// mtshan 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsangs// rnam dag thig le khyab brdal che// srid zhi mnyam nyid g.yang du skyil// snod bcud dwangs ma rdzogs ldan gyi// dpal 'bar bkra shis kun khyab shog

zhe khyim ni/ kyai/ rdo rje thod phreng brgyud pa'i sdes// dbang bskur dam nos dge gnyen che// zhe khyim dgra las rnam rgyal zhes// sku mdog mthing gsal zhi ma khro// khrab ber gsol zhing 'khor gsum 251)bskor// g.yas na dar mdung g.yon nor bu// chibs su rta nag 'phur shes chibs// 'khor du rma rigs mang pos bskor// rnal 'byor bdag la brtse phyir gshegs// mthun pa'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang*// dri bzang bsang gi mchod par bcas// dkar gtor rgyan ldan khyed la 'bul// rgyal khams bde zhing bstan pa dar// sdang ba'i dgra bo myur du sgrol// lo legs 'bru 'phel chos spyod sogs// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ chos kyi nyi mas so// rag nyag ni/ hrīḥrdo rje drag rtsal brgyud pa'i sdes// dam la bzhag pa'i dge gnyen che// sku lha legs pa'i blo gros khyod// sgrub mchog bdag gis 'bod tsa na// tha tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir byon// cha lugs ma nges sna tshogs ston// chos kyi dgra bla mdzad pa'i tshe// sku mdog dkar gsal 'od zer 'phro// khrab ber sbrags ma lus la gon/ 252) /g.yas pas mda' dar gnam la g.yug /g.yon pas dpal gyi be'u bsnams// chibs su rta ser 'phur shes chibs// ser ldan 'khyil pa'i yul lhas bskor// badz+ra dhub pe las byung ba'i// dri bzang bsang gi du ba'i gseb// mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs rnams// gang la ci dgos yon tan 'byung*// mchod do 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ khyed la bcol pa'i phrin las ni// rgyal khams bde zhing bstan pa dar// sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo sod// rang gi ri dwags 'tsho skyong gis// bsam pa chos mthun 'grub par mdzod/ chos kyi nyi mas so// shel dkar ni/ kyai/ stong gsal thabs dang shes rab las// rang byung mchod pa'i phyag rgya che// lhun grub bdud rtsi can gyi shing*// 'byung ba me rlung sbyor ba las// dri ma gtsang byed shugs las grub// mchod pa'i sprin phung mkha' la 'phro// 'dod rgu'i char pa ci yang 'bebs// 'od gsal thig le

253)chen po'i mdangs// rdo rje bdug spos rnam thar gyi// bkod pa'i khyad par bsam mi khyab// zag med ye shes rol pa yis// shel dkar rdo rje blo gros rtsal// 'khor bcas bsang ngo mnga' gsol lo// thub dbang rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog phyogs bcu kun tu rgyas pa dang*// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas// gar 'gro gar 'dug bkra shis shing*// dge mtshan dpal du 'bar ba dang*// phyogs dus kun tu bde legs shog ma chen ni/ kyai/ bde chen kun bzang yum gyi thugs las sprul// 'khor 'das kun la khyab pa'i cho 'phrul ston// srid pa gsum po ma lus dbang du mdzad// ngo bo shes rab pha rol phyin ma ste// gzugs sku'i rnam rol dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i tshe// ma chen sku bla gsang ba zhes su grags// rnal 'byor bde ba'i ye shes bskyed pa mo// ma sring ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams// bsang mchod ye shes bdud rtsis bsang zhing mchod/ 254) /mi mthun rkyen zlog mthun mkhyen bsam pa sgrubs// rig 'dzin gong ma'i tha tshig ma g.yel bar// rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// mchod cing bstod pa'i ngo so ma chung bar// gar 'gro gang 'dug mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrubs// mi la nad yams phyugs la god kha dang*// zhing la btsa' sad ser gsum btang zhig khyad par skyin thang ser ba'i 'grims lam chod// 'brug gi skad gtsog sprin nag gur khang shig /rlung gi ngar sod thog gi mda' mo choms// lo dgra lo nad kun zhi yul phyogs 'dir// 'bru bcud lo tog legs pa'i phrin las mdzod// bkra shis bde legs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog sang yag ni/ kyai// slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan gnas gzhi'i bdag po ni// sang yag rdo rje rgyal mtshan che// bka' 'khor bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// snang srid 255)'khor bcas thams cad kyang*// gdod nas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che// ma dag mtshan ma ming yang med// thams cad sangs rgyas rang bzhin phyir// da dus snyigs ma'i bskal pa 'dir// bdag cag mos pa'i bu la gzigs// thugs rje nus pa bsam yas pas// smon pa'i 'bras bu mi bslu mdzod// bar chad bdud kyi 'phrang las sgrol// dam sri 'byung po'i tsha ngar choms// dus min 'chi ba bzlog tu gsol// chos mthun dpal dang nyams rtogs spel// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam byin rlobs// nam zhig mi rtag mngon gyur tshe// gnad gcod med par dran shes ldan// dri med rig pa'i rang ngo sprod// ka ti shel gyi sbu gu phyes// rdor sems gsang ba'i lam du spor// gal te bar dor 'khyams gyur kyang*// 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang zhi bar mdzod// 'gro ba rigs drug skye sgo chod// bde chen dag pa'i zhing du skyol/

256)/sangs rgyas sras su dbugs byung zhing*// de srid snyed dka'i rin po che// dal 'byor don yod ma gyur bar// mi mthun 'chi las rab rgyal zhing*// dbang phyug ma tshang med 'byor bas// bstan 'gror sman yon che ldan te// tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis byang*// chos kyi rgyal po rdo rje'i sku// rtag pa dam pa'i dpal brnyes shog

khro 'bar ni/ kyai/ dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka'i// yang sprul khro 'bar mche bdun ni// o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng dang*// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga ru// khas blang dam bcas dran gyis la// 'dir bshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi// mchod gtor mthun pa'i dam rdzas bzhes// gang bcol phrin las thogs med sgrubs// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// tsa tri mu tri du ru muñtsa sa pā ri wā ra ma hā pañtsa bha ling+ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ skong zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai/ bka' srung bstan srung dgyes pa'i rjas/ 257)/bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun// dar zab spyan gzigs sprin ltar gtibs// rnga dung rol mo'i sgra dbyangs bcas// lha tshogs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang// zangs lcags dung gser g.yu bcas kyi// khrab rmog 'khor gsum mda' mdung gri// ba dan ru mtshon sna tshogs kyis// lha tshogs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// zangs lcags dung ser g.yu bcas kyis// khrab rmog 'khor gsum mda' mdung gri// ba dan ru mtshon sna tshogs kyis/ lha tshogs= rta dmar sha rkyang ri dwags tshogs// mdzes sdug dar dang rin chen gyi// rgyan ldan rgyug 'dur breng se breng*// lha tshogs 'khor bcas= bya dmar khyi dmar gcan zan rigs// bya nag rdo rje'i mchu can sogs// bya rigs lce spyang sna tshogs kyis// lha tshogs 'khor bcas= gzhan yang gang la dgyes pa'i rdzas// gcig las du mar 'char ba yi// mig 'phrul lta bu'i mchod rdzas dang*// bskang rdzas brngan rdzas sna tshogs kyis// lha klu bdud btsan rigs gtogs pa'i// btsan 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang*// yang 'khor sprul pa bsam yas bcas// ma lus lus pa med par mchod// thugs dam gnyen po dgyes 258) bskangs te// rnal 'byor bdag cag bsrung bya yi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor rlung rta bskyed// chos mthun 'dod dgu dbang du bsdus// phas rgol dgra bgegs rtsad nas chod// sgrub mchog bu slob bu bzhin skyongs// gang bcol phrin las myur 'grub mdzod/

sa ma ya ho/ rag phral ni/ kyai/ he ru ka dpal thod phreng rtsal// mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bka' sdod che// rag phram rdo rje khyung drag 'tshal// sras dang btsun mo bka' 'khor bcas// bsang mchod mgron du spyan 'dren na// mthun pa'i rdzas kyi 'byor pas bskang*// rig 'dzin thugs mchog drag tsal gyi// spyan sngar dam bcas ma bsnyel bar// dkar phyogs dbu 'phang dgung du bstod// nag phyogs bdud rigs chom la phob// char chu dus su 'bab pa dang*// lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa yis// skye rgu bde skyid dpal gyis srungs// nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi ba dang*// tshe bsod dbang thang 259) dar rgyas mdzod// btsa' sad ser gsum zhi ba dang*// yul gyi sa bcud dpal 'byor rgyas// gzhis byes kun tu srung skyobs mdzod// mdor na yid la gang bsam pa'i// 'dod don lhun gyis grub par mdzod// 'bu rong ni/ kyai// chos 'khor skyong zhing yul ljongs 'dir// mgon skyabs sdong grogs byed pa yi// gzhi gnas yul gyi bdag po che// gnyan po btsan rgod 'bu rong ni// bka' 'khor bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas// dri bzang shing rtsi'i dud pas bsangs// ja chang 'o zho'i phud kyis mchod// phye mar 'bru sman dkor chas brngan// gser skyems g.yu sngon sbyar bas gsol// mnol ba sangs la mkhon pa bsdum// dbu 'phang bstod cing gzi byin skyed// gnas mgron ngo so ma chung bar// mchod bstod bzhes la srung skyobs mdzod// pad 'byung kun bzang shes rab sogs// grub pa'i rig 'dzin mchog rnams kyi/ 260)/bka' bsgos dam bzhag ma bsnyel bar// nyes dgu zhi zhing legs tshogs kyi// dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ dkar mdzangs ni/ kyai// 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi yul// 'gro 'dul phrin las gnas kyi cha// dpal gyis gtams pa'i tha gru la// dbang bsgyur gzhi yi bdag po ni// lha btsan rgyal ba dkar mdzangs che// bsang zhing mchod pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// rnal 'byor bdag gi bos pa'i tshe// yid ltar mgyogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// ma thogs myur du gshegs nas kyang*// dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri bsung zhim// ro bda' reg 'jam du mas mchod// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// longs spyod 'dod yon sprin gyis mchod// rin chen dkor cha sman dang 'bru// dar zab bal tshon dong tses mchod// bya gcan ri dwags g.yung dwags dang*// chu gnas

261)sa 'dzul gzugs kyis mchod// rtsi bcud phye mar gangs ltar spungs// dkar mngar skyems phud mtsho ltar bskyil// 'brang rgyas shel tshig thang mar brdal// mda' dar go mtshon rten gyis mchod// bzang shing bdud rtsi can gyi tshogs// gtsang byed 'bar ba'i me la bsregs// g.yu dud lho sprin nam mkha' gang*// dri bzang ngad pas bar snang khyab// 'dod yon mchod sprin dpag med 'phro// zhi ba bdud rtsi'i bsang gis brngan// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes nas kyang*// bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod/ kam ri ni/ kyai/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog drag rtsal gyi// tha tshig rdo rje'i yal gam la// gnas shing sdong grogs mdzad pa yi// gnas gzhi'i bdag po mthu rtsal can// kam ri dkar mo ri bkra ni// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// sngon tshe 262)pad+ma ka ra dang*// lo chen bai ro tsa na sogs// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga ru// zhal bzhes tha tshig dran mdzod la// dmag 'khrug lo nyes nad yams sogs// dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sol// char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs legs// snod bcud bde skyid 'byor pa spel// bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dgung du bstod// rnal 'byor bdag dang yon bdag la// byams pa'i thugs kyis g.yel med dgongs// kha 'dzin sdong grogs rgyab brten mdzod// gzhis byes kun tu srung zhing skyobs// yid la 'dod rgu'i don rnams sgrubs// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba yi// dge legs snang bas sa gsum khyab// bkra shis dpal 'byor gong 'phel shog dbu rtse ni/ kyai/ yul bdag dge bsnyen mthu bo che// dbu rtse rdo rje dregs tshogs 'joms// yab yum mched 'khor bran dang bcas// dad mos gdung bas spyan 'dren na// dgyes pa'i stabs kyi gshegs su gsol/ 263)/tsan+dan ba lu a gar sogs// bzang shing dud pas nam mkha' gang*// phye mar dkor cha ri ltar spungs// gser skyems btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil// dbang po lnga la dgyes bskyed pa'i// 'dod rgu ma tshang med pa 'dis// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// dga' mgu mnyes shing tshim nas kyang*// nad mug 'khrugs rtsod la sogs pa// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzod// bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dgung du bstod// yul khams skye rgur dge legs spel// bde skyid yar zla ltar rgyas mdzod// pad 'byung dam pa bde gshegs sogs// rdo rje slob dpon mchog rnams kyis// zhal mthong gsung thos bka' bsgos pa'i// tha tshig gnyen po ma bsnyel bar// ci ltar bcol pa'i phrin las kun// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod/

'ug mgo ni/ kyai/ gdod nas rnam dag 'og min zhing*// ye shes rol pa'i rang rtsal las/ 264)/gnas yul zhing gi bkod par shar// dpal kun 'dus pa'i gnas mchog gi /phan gnod byed por dbang ba'i lha// 'ug mgo rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal// mchod pa'i mgron du 'dir gshegs la// phye mar gser skyems 'bru sna sogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas mchod// bzang shing spos kyi dud pa'i sprin// gnam sa bar nang yongs gang bas// sdom pa dam tshig nyams pa dang*// mi dge mi rung las bgyis pas// rten dang brten par bcas pa la// nyams grib dme mnol phog pa bsangs// byang zhing dag nas sor chud de// sku gsung thugs mchog dgyes shing tshims// gzi brjid ldan zhing mthu tsal tshe// byin rlabs dpal du 'bar ba yis// 'gro la srung skyobs sba ba dang*// thun mongs pa mchog gi dngos grub sogs// 'dod rgu yid bzhin bstsal du gsol/ tshe dpal ni/ kyai// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams dang*// snang zhing 265)srid pa'i 'jig rten na// 'jig rten 'das dang la 'das pa'i// mchod 'os mgron rigs ma lus dang*// lha klus bdag zo dor tshogs// khyad par gnas mchog 'di yi bdag /tshe dpal rgyal ba don kun grub// 'khor tshogs sprul par bcas pa rnams// de ring gtsang ma'i gnas 'dir gshegs// rang mthun mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// g.yu shug ba lu mkhan dkar sogs// dri zhim spos kyi shing bsregs pa'i// bsangs dud nam mkha' bar nang khyab// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sogs// 'dod yon mchod rdzas dpag med 'phro// so so'i thugs la gang bzhed pa// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yis// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// lha srung gnyan po khyed rnams la// ro bag dme yug thab dang gzhob// byad gtad ngan sngags dam grib sogs// 'bag btsog mnol ba

266)ci mchis kun// de ring nyid nas sangs gyur cig dbu 'phang dgung las mtho bar shog 'jig rten kun dang yul phyogs 'dir// mi nad phyugs nad 'thab rtsod dang*// btsa' sad ser gsum zhi bar mdzod// dgra rkun gcan zan 'tshe ba zlog /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs legs// bstan pa dar ba'i sdong grogs mdzod// khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams// byes su 'gro na bsu skyel gyis// gzhis su 'dug na rgyab brten gyis// legs kha rgyal kha dgung du bstod// bsam pa'i blo kha chos la bsgyur// 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ ye rang ni/ kyai// yul ni shar phyogs mdo khams sgang*// dpal gyi yul la dbang bsgyur ba// ye rang legs pa'i blo gros che// lha khyod mchod cing brngan pa'i rdzas// bsang chen dud sprin nam mkha' gang*// 'dod yon rnam lnga char du 'bebs// ja chang 'o zho'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ 267)/phye mar sman 'bru dar zab dang*// rin chen dkor cha dkar mngar zas// bya gcan ri dwags g.yung dwags sogs// mkho dgu'i 'byor ba ma tshang med// dngos bshams yid kyi sprul pas brngan// rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje yis// bka' bsgos tha tshig dran mdzod ma// 'jig rten bde ba'i phrin las sgrubs// khyad par yul gyi dge legs spel// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// gzhi ru 'dug na bu bzhin skyongs// byes su bgrod na 'bral med 'grogs// 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs// mi la na tsha phyugs la god// zhing la lo dgra ma btang zhig kha 'dzin rgyab brten sdong grogs mdzod// 'dod pa yid bzhin bsgrub tu gsol// dbu 'phang gnyan po dgung du bstod// bkra shis dpal 'byor rab rgyas shog g.yu rtse ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin skye 'gag bral ba'i ngang*// hūm̐ bhūm̐ las byung 268)bsang dang 'dod yon tshogs// yul lha'i dbang shes dgyes pa bskyed byed pa'i// mi bzad rgyan 'khor nam mkha' mdzod dbang bsgyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlab/ kyai/ chos dbyings 'gyur med rnam thar gsum ldan klong*// 'khor 'das chos kun spros mtshan nyer zhi yang*// bde stong lhun grub rtsal snang rol pa las// phan gnod byed por dbang ba yul gyi lha// pad+ma thod phreng rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi// bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i lha gnyan che// mtshan snyan rgyal ba g.yu rtse drag po rtsal// sras dang btsun mo g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams// 'dir gshegs rang rang 'tshams par dgyes rol bzhugs// dngos bshams yid sprul dri bzang dud sprin dang*// phye mar ser skyems ja chang zas sna'i rigs// g.yag lug ra sogs ri g.yung gzugs 'gros 'bul// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha 'khor bcas kyi// dbang shes tshim nas mnyes pa 'byung gyur cig /yid 269)la smon pa'i mthun rkyen spel byed pa'i// yul lha mthu chen dbu 'phang yar yar bstod// phog thug 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa// mkha' ltar dag pa'i thugs kyis yongs bzod nas// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' bsgos dran mdzod la// rnam bzhi'i las dang gzhis byes bya kun dang*// bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed don phrin las spel// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i legs tshogs kun// 'bad med lhun grub phywa g.yang mtsho ltar bskyil// ljongs 'dis mtshon te nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon// mi mthun rgud pa'i skal ngan mthar byed cing*// nad mtshon mu ge sad ser mi 'byung zhing*// lo legs 'bru 'phel dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig karma 'gyur med pas so/ dmu rdo ni/ kyai/ srid gsum zil gnon he ru ka 270)/rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng dang*// sprul pa'i lo chen rnam snang mdzad// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// gnas gter brgya rtsa'i srung ma che// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po yi// bstan srung rgyal mod mu rdo zhes// sku mdog mthing nag gzi 'bar zhing*// phyag g.yas ba dan dkar po phyar// rnal 'byor bdag gi grags pa spel// g.yon pas yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// dgos 'dod bsam pa yid bzhin sgrub// rkyang bu kha dkar rta la chibs// bse yi khrab rmog btsan po gsol// 'khor du dregs pa can rnams kyis// brdzus pa'i bya dkar glad na lding*/

khyi nag dom bu rol du rgyug mdun na stag gzig 'gying ngar sgrog /'phar spyang dred sogs gdug pa'i tshogs// bstan dgra'i srog chod rnal 'byor skyong*// 'khor bcas gdung bas 'bod lags na/ 271)/mchod pa'i gnas 'dir myur du gshegs// mthun pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi shing*// dag byed zhugs la 'bar ba'i sprin// mi zad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// mkho rgu'i 'byor pa phun tshogs 'dis// bstan pa'i bka' srung chen po bsang*// rnal 'byor dgra bla chen po bsang*// bstan dgra nyams pa'i gshed ma bsang*// rgyal mod mu rdo 'khor bcas bsang*// yul lha mthun rkyen dbu 'phang bstod// phog thug nongs pa gang mchis bshags// rig 'dzin rdo rje thod phreng dang*// paṇa chen dri med zla shar sogs// brgyud pa'i bla mas bka' bsgos bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par rdo rje snying po yi// ring lugs dar zhing rgyas par spel// rnal 'byor bdag gi kha 'dzin mdzod// rnam bzhi'i las dang gzhis 272)byes kun// gang brtsam phrin las kun 'grub cing*// rtag tu srung skyobs sdong grogs gyis/ mdo sngags bstan 'dzin pas so// rdo rje ngang dkar ni/ kyai/ ka ye gson dang rdo rje ngang dkar khyed/ kha can ljongs smra shod go 'jo yi// ga na gnas kyang gnas bdag khyed yin pas// nga yi bka' sdod pho nya khyod bsten phyir// ca co'i dbyangs dang rol mos spyan drang ngo*// cha lugs mi dkar rta dkar sba lcag bsnams// ja chang phud dang gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul// nya rgyas zla ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can// ta thā ga ta'i bstan srung khyed yin pas// tha mal 'dre ngan gzhan dang ma bsdong bar// da ni bdag cag rnams la kha 'dzin mdzod// na tsha shi chad god kha thams cad zlog pa de pu de'i phrag dog ma byed cig /pha rol gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs// ba mor nyi zer phog ltar med par mdzod// ma gyur

273)'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir// tsa kha lo phyugs rtag tu rgyas pa dang*// tsha brang 'du ba'i nad rnams med par mdzod// dza ya rig 'dzin rnams kyi bka' bzhin du// wa ler mngon shes ldan pa'i lha khyod kyis// zhwa ltar bstan dang bstan 'dzin spyi bor bskur// za byed btsan bdud dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams// 'a 'ur 'brug sgra thog ser drag por bcas// ya mtshan sman btsun spom ra gnyen po sogs// ra can rgyal mo khri dang bcas pa yi// la can smar shod gzhi bdag thams cad bsang*// sha tsha snying rje pha khu spun zla ltar// sa cha gar 'gro gar 'dug bsu bskyel mdzod// ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo 'dzum mdangs can// a la la ho ya mtshan dngos grub stsol/ oṃ de wa tsan+t+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

mkhas grub chags med rin po ches mdzad pa'o// ces dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub chos gling gi gnas bdag rnams la lha bsang so sor spros pa 'di'ang*/ lha bsang 274) rgyal brngan gtong ba'i dus su nye bar mkho bas rkyen byas dus mtha'i snga 'gyur ba'i a mye dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis brjod tshig byin rlabs tshe bar dmigs te/ rgyal bas lung bstan mdzod chen rnam lnga'i shing rta ba rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i gsung rab las bsdus pa dge legs 'phel// gtor ma ni/ so tho la dkar gtor rtse rgyal/ dpal 'dzam la dkar dmar/ ra nu/ dmar 'gu/ sde ring*/ khro 'bar bcas la dmar gtor bzhi/ gzhan rnams la dkar gtor nyer dgu/ kun la g.yag lug ra gsum/ ri g.yung*/ bya rigs/ gzugs 'gros kyis bskor ba bshams la dbul lo// dge'o//
